Your team

A team shares one review queue: when anyone assesses, assigns or dismisses an update, everyone in the team sees it, and every change is kept in an audit trail. Saved and followed updates stay personal.

Your sign-in and team data are kept in PV Info's database. Only your team can see its queue; only you can see your own workspace.
